items.title: Milford Dolliole Interview, 1965-05-22
items.q: Albert Giles had a set of four of them.

ctx.x: Albert Giles had a set of four of them. Yeah, he did. I remember Baby Dodds had a set of four in Chicago. I always saw his. Yeah. And what kind of cymbals did you use?
I had one large crash cymbal and then I had a... Was that the Chinese one?
